title: cpf1 cloning
author: Jaclyn Winter

steps_raw.instruction: Cpf1 purification (Adapted from Targeted mutagenesis in mice via electroporation of Cpf1 ribonucleoproteins)
Transform your favourite protease deficient E.coli strain with the Cpf1 plasmid : pDEST-hisMBP-AsCpf1-EC
Culture 2 L of LB with Ampicillin (original protocol says Carbamycin, but we don’t have and work as well)
When OD=0.6 , culture was ice cooled, induced with 0.5mM IPTG and incubated for 14-18 h at 16C
Cells were harvested and frozen at -80C

Cell pellet resuspended in 50 mL of lysis buffer (50 mM, HEPES pH 7, 200 mM NaCl, 5 mM MgCl2, 1 mM DTT, 10 mM imidazole) supplemented with 1 mg/ml lysozyme. (original protocol also calls for a protease inhibitor, but we have little and kept for microsomes).
Lysate cells by sonication for 10 mins on ice (60% duty cycle and power set to 6 on a branson sonifier with microtip)
Cell lysate cleared by centrifugation at 20000 g for 30 min at 4C.
Supernatant filtered with an 0.22 micron filter
Cleared lysate incubated with 2mL of Ni-NTA solution for 4h at 4C.
Ni-NTA poured over a column, washed with 100mL 2M NaCl and bound protein eluted with 30mL 250 mM imidazole
The solution containing the protein was buffer exchanged to lysis buffer lacking magnesium and imidazole an concentrated to 1mL
Cpf1- double gRNA complexed digestion protocol
Measure concentration of protein stock and dilute to 0.1 ug/uL (this is approx. 1 U/uL)
Dilute gRNA to 300ng/uL in IDTE buffer (10 mM Tris, pH 8.0, 0.1 mM EDTA)
Make 10x restriction buffer (100 mM NaCl, 50 mM TrisHCl,pH 7.9, 10 mM MgCl2, 1mM DTT) (this you can keep at -20C for up to a year and use around 5 times freeze-thaw, or keep at 4C for a week)
To finish the reaction and offload the DNA from the enzyme use 5x Stop solution (30% glycerol, 1.2% SDS, 250 mM EDTA) tip= add glycerol last.

Use DNA as you would for a normal restriction digest. Agarose purify the vector, and any other fragment (if <50 kb). For larger fragments just EtOH precipitate. ( Column will shear anything bigger than that).
Ligation can be made with T4 ligase from NEB.
